title: Beatrix and the Machine
author: T. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Wendell Whitlock, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
